search.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the search field at the top of the Home screen, which filters the viewer's pinned apps and communities and the communities they can join. Ctrl+K is the keyboard shortcut that puts the cursor in this field (Command+K on a Mac, / also works); keep the key name as written.

search.label.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of the Home screen.

search.clear.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the × button inside Home's search field: empties the field.

search.results_one.description: Small heading over the app tiles on Home while a search is active. {{count}} is how many of the viewer's apps match.

search.results_other.description: Small heading over the app tiles on Home while a search is active. {{count}} is how many of the viewer's apps match.

grid.heading.description: Heading over the grid of app tiles on the Home screen: the apps this person keeps a tile for. The same name is used in "Pin to Home".

grid.loading.description: Read by screen readers while the grid of app tiles on Home is still loading.

grid.noMatches.text: No apps match “{{query}}”. Clear the search and try <0>Discover communities</0> below.
grid.noMatches.description: Shown in place of Home's app tiles when the search finds none of the viewer's apps. {{query}} is what the person typed. The numbered tag highlights the name of the section further down the Home screen; use the same words as that section's heading.

grid.showAll_one.description: Button under the grid of app tiles on Home: reveals the rows of tiles that are folded away. {{count}} is the total number of the viewer's apps.

grid.showAll_other.description: Button under the grid of app tiles on Home: reveals the rows of tiles that are folded away. {{count}} is the total number of the viewer's apps.

grid.notice.offline.text: You're offline. Apps you've opened before will appear here once this device has loaded them.
grid.notice.offline.description: Shown in place of Home's app tiles when the device has no connection and no apps are stored yet.

grid.notice.loadFailed.description: Title of the error card shown in place of Home's app tiles when the list of apps could not be fetched.

grid.tile.tip.text: {{app}}. Hold or right-click for app actions
grid.tile.tip.description: Tooltip of an app's tile on the Home screen. {{app}} is the app's name; keep it first. Holding the tile or right-clicking it opens a menu of actions for that app.

grid.tile.actions.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small menu button on an app's card: opens the menu of things to do with that app.

grid.tile.remixedFrom.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small badge on an app's tile: this app is a version made from another app, the original. {{app}} is the original's name.

grid.tile.remixedFromDeleted.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small badge on an app's tile: this app is a version made from another app. Used when the original has been deleted; the app is shown as the word "deleted" in angle brackets, as it always has been. {{open}} and {{close}} are the angle brackets < and > that the code puts around the word; keep them around the translated word.

grid.tile.audience.invited.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small people badge on an app's tile: the app belongs to a community people join by invitation.

grid.tile.audience.solo.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small lock badge on an app's tile: only the viewer can see and use this app.

grid.tile.retryNamed.description: Accessible name of the Retry button on a tile whose app failed to build: tries building it again. {{app}} is the app's name.

grid.tile.status.creating.description: Small status line under an app's name on its Home tile: the app is being set up and is not running yet.

grid.tile.status.awaitingSecrets.description: Small status line under an app's name on its Home tile: the app is waiting for its required secret values (API keys and the like) to be set.

grid.tile.status.error.description: Small status line under an app's name on its Home tile: the app failed to build or start.

layout.saveFailed.text: Couldn’t save your home screen layout.
layout.saveFailed.description: Brief notice when the new arrangement of tiles on Home, after a drag, could not be saved.

create.label.description: Label under the dashed + tile at the end of Home's grid, and on the small dashed-plus New project button beside "Show all N apps" when the grid is folded and has no room for the tile: starts a new project (an app and the community that builds it).

create.tip.text: Start a project: an app for you or for a community
create.tip.description: Tooltip of the + tile at the end of Home's grid, and of the small New project button beside "Show all N apps" that stands in for it there.

create.disabledHint.text: View your app allowance or request more slots.
create.disabledHint.description: Last sentence of the + tile's tooltip when the viewer has used up the number of apps they may create: what pressing it does instead. A slot is room for one app.

create.lockedTip.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the + tile at the end of Home's grid when the viewer cannot create another app right now — and of the small New project button beside "Show all N apps" that stands in for it there, in the same state. {{hint}} is one whole sentence saying what pressing it does ("View your app allowance or request more slots.").

myApps.added.description: Brief notice after an app's tile was added to the viewer's Home. "Pinned apps" is the name of that section.

myApps.removed.description: Brief notice after an app's tile was taken off the viewer's Home. "Pinned apps" is the name of that section.

myApps.updateFailed.description: Brief notice when adding an app to Pinned apps, or removing it, did not go through. {{reason}} is the server's own error message, or a code such as "HTTP 500".

leave.confirm.title.description: Title of the question asked when someone presses "Joined" on an app to stop being a member of its community. {{community}} is the app's name.

leave.confirm.private.text: You will lose access to it until someone invites you back.
leave.confirm.private.description: Body of the "Leave …?" question when the app's community is private.

leave.confirm.public.text: You won’t be able to propose or vote on its changes until you join again.
leave.confirm.public.description: Body of the "Leave …?" question when the app's community is public. "Changes" is a noun.

leave.confirm.button.description: Confirming button of the "Leave …?" question: stop being a member of the app's community. A verb.

membership.joined.description: Brief notice after the viewer joined an app's community. {{community}} is the app's name.

membership.left.description: Brief notice after the viewer stopped being a member of an app's community. {{community}} is the app's name. "Left" is the past of leave, not a direction.

membership.joinFailed.description: Brief notice when joining an app's community failed. {{reason}} is the server's own error message, or a code such as "HTTP 500".

membership.leaveFailed.description: Brief notice when leaving an app's community failed. {{reason}} is the server's own error message, or a code such as "HTTP 500".

menu.updated.description: Line in the header of an app tile's menu: when the app's latest version went live. {{when}} is a short relative time such as "3d ago" or "just now".

menu.details.label.description: Item in an app tile's menu on Home: opens the hub of the app's community, its project page.

menu.details.tip.text: Who it is for, what is changing, and how to join
menu.details.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Go to community" item in an app tile's menu: what the community's hub shows.

menu.editMyApps.label.description: Last item in the menu of an app tile in the Pinned apps grid on Home: puts the grid into edit mode, where tiles can be moved and removed. "Edit" is a verb; "Pinned apps" is the name of the section.

menu.editMyApps.tip.text: Move and remove the apps in Pinned apps
menu.editMyApps.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Edit Pinned apps" item in an app tile's menu on Home. "Move" and "remove" are verbs.

menu.github.label.description: Item in an app's menu, for an app whose code is on GitHub: opens the app's source code repository on GitHub in a new tab.

menu.github.tip.description: Tooltip of the "View on GitHub" item in an app's menu. "Open" is a verb.

menu.code.label.description: Item in an app's menu, for an app whose code is on Homeroom's own git host rather than GitHub: opens the app's source code in a new tab. "View" is a verb.

menu.code.tip.description: Tooltip of the "View code" item in an app's menu. "Open" is a verb.

menu.myApps.add.description: Item in an app's menu: puts a tile for the app on the viewer's Home. "Pinned apps" is the name of that section.

menu.myApps.remove.description: Item in an app's menu: takes the app's tile off the viewer's Home. "Pinned apps" is the name of that section.

menu.myApps.showAgainTip.text: Show this app in Pinned apps again. You keep your builder access either way.
menu.myApps.showAgainTip.description: Tooltip of "Pin to Home" in an app's menu, for someone who builds the app and had hidden its tile.

menu.myApps.hideTip.text: Hide this app from Pinned apps. It stays live and you keep your builder access.
menu.myApps.hideTip.description: Tooltip of "Unpin from Home" in an app's menu, for someone who builds the app. "Live" means still running for its users.

menu.notifications.label.description: Item in an app's menu: opens the choices of what this app may notify the viewer about.

menu.notifications.tip.text: Choose what this app can notify you about, here and on your phone.
menu.notifications.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Notifications" item in an app's menu.

menu.widget.edit.description: Item in an app's menu in the iPhone app, when the app is already on the Homeroom widget: reveals the strip on Home where the widget's apps are arranged. Homeroom is the product's name.

menu.widget.add.description: Item in an app's menu in the iPhone app: adds the app to the Homeroom widget on the phone's home screen. Homeroom is the product's name.

menu.phoneHome.add.description: Item in an app's menu in the Android app: puts a shortcut to the app on the phone's home screen.

menu.phoneHome.addFailed.description: Brief notice when putting an app on the phone's home screen, or on the Homeroom widget, failed. {{reason}} is the error the phone reported.

menu.install.label.description: Item in an app's menu in a phone browser: opens the page that explains how to install the app on the phone's home screen with its own icon.

menu.install.tip.text: Put this app on your phone’s home screen with its own icon
menu.install.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Add to Home Screen" item in an app's menu.

menu.retry.description: Item in the menu of an app that failed to build, shown to its creator: tries building and starting the app again.

menu.buildLog.label.description: Item in the menu of an app whose last build failed: opens the log of that build. "Build" is a noun.

menu.buildLog.tip.text: See why the last build/deploy failed
menu.buildLog.tip.description: Tooltip of "View build log" in an app's menu when the server gave no failure reason of its own.

menu.checkUpdates.label.description: Item in an app's menu, for administrators: checks whether the app's repository has a newer version to deploy.

menu.checkUpdates.checking.description: Replaces the label of "Check for updates" in an app's menu while the check is running.

menu.checkUpdates.failedHttp.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" failed and the server gave no message. {{status}} is the HTTP status number, such as 500.

menu.checkUpdates.failed.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" could not reach the server. {{reason}} is the browser's own error message.

menu.remix.label.description: Item in an app's menu: makes the viewer their own version of the app, a project of their own made from it, to change freely.

menu.remix.sub.description: Second line, and tooltip, of the "Make your own" item in an app's menu.

menu.lock.lock.description: Item in an app's menu, for administrators: from then on a change to the app also needs an administrator's yes vote. "Lock" is a verb.

menu.lock.unlock.description: Item in an app's menu, for administrators, when the app is locked: lifts the extra administrator vote. A verb.

menu.lock.lockTip.text: Lock this app. An admin yes vote will also be required to merge changes.
menu.lock.lockTip.description: Tooltip of "Lock app" in an app's menu. To merge a change is to accept it into the app.

menu.lock.unlockTip.text: App locked: merges also need an admin yes vote. Click to unlock.
menu.lock.unlockTip.description: Tooltip of "Unlock app" in an app's menu. A merge is the acceptance of a change into the app.

menu.lock.failedHttp.description: Brief notice when locking or unlocking an app failed and the server gave no message. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

menu.lock.failed.description: Brief notice when locking or unlocking an app could not reach the server. {{reason}} is the browser's own error message.

menu.settings.description: Item in an app's menu, for people who manage the app: opens the app's settings dialog.

menu.report.description: Item in an app's menu: reports the app to Homeroom's moderators as breaking the rules. "Report" is a verb.

check.noDetails.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" when the server's answer said nothing about the outcome.

check.noDrift.title.description: Title of the question asked after "Check for updates" found the app already runs its repository's newest version (commit).

check.noDrift.message.text: Force a rebuild anyway? (Useful if env vars or platform code changed.)
check.noDrift.message.description: Body of the question asked after "Check for updates" found nothing new. "Env vars" are the app's environment variables.

check.noDrift.confirm.description: Confirming button of the "Force a rebuild anyway?" question: builds and deploys the app again. A verb.

check.rebuild.started.text: Rebuild started. Watch the version pill.
check.rebuild.started.description: Brief notice after a forced rebuild of an app began. The version pill is the small chip showing the app's version, where progress appears.

check.rebuild.failed.description: Brief notice when a forced rebuild of an app could not be started. {{reason}} is the server's own error message.

check.deployRequested.text: Main has a newer version ({{sha}}). Deploying it now: watch the version pill.
check.deployRequested.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" found a newer version and asked for it to be deployed; the deploy runs in the background. {{sha}} is the first seven characters of that version's commit id. The version pill is the small chip showing the app's version, where progress appears.

check.inFlight.text: A redeploy is already in progress for this app.
check.inFlight.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" when the app is already being deployed again.

check.firstSeen.text: Recorded current SHA ({{sha}}). Future drift will trigger a redeploy.
check.firstSeen.description: Brief notice after the first "Check for updates" on an app. {{sha}} is the first seven characters of the current commit id. Drift means the repository moving ahead of what is deployed.

check.fetchFailed.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" could not read the app's repository. {{reason}} is the server's own error message.

check.fetchFailedUnknown.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" could not read the app's repository and the server gave no reason.

check.invalidRepo.text: This app has an invalid repo URL.
check.invalidRepo.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" when the address of the app's repository is not usable.

check.finished.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" ended with an outcome this screen has no sentence for. {{status}} is the server's own status code, such as no_change.

time.justNow.description: A relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu: less than a minute ago. Lower case because it follows another word.

time.minutesAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of minutes; "m" abbreviates minutes.

time.minutesAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of minutes; "m" abbreviates minutes.

time.hoursAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of hours; "h" abbreviates hours.

time.hoursAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of hours; "h" abbreviates hours.

time.daysAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of days; "d" abbreviates days.

time.daysAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of days; "d" abbreviates days.

time.monthsAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of months; "mo" abbreviates months.

time.monthsAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of months; "mo" abbreviates months.

time.yearsAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of years; "y" abbreviates years.

time.yearsAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of years; "y" abbreviates years.

widget.heading.description: Heading of the strip on Home, in the iPhone app, where the apps shown on the Homeroom home-screen widget are arranged. Homeroom is the product's name.

widget.help.toggle.text: How to add the widget to your home screen
widget.help.toggle.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small ⓘ button beside the "Homeroom widget" heading: shows or hides the instructions.

widget.help.steps.text: <0>Add the widget to your home screen:</0> touch and hold an empty area of your iPhone home screen, tap <1>Edit</1> → <2>Add Widget</2> (or the <3>+</3>), search for <4>Homeroom</4>, pick a size and tap <5>Add Widget</5>. The apps below appear on it automatically.
widget.help.steps.description: Instructions shown in the widget strip on Home in the iPhone app. Every numbered tag is emphasis. "Edit" and "Add Widget" are the names of buttons in iOS: use the names iOS shows in your language. Homeroom is the product's name; keep it.

widget.close.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the "Done" button on the widget strip on Home: hides the strip.

widget.hint.withTiles.text: Drag tiles to reorder. Drag cards from Pinned apps here to add them.
widget.hint.withTiles.description: Hint under the app tiles in the widget strip on Home. "Pinned apps" is the name of the grid below it.

widget.hint.empty.text: Drag a card from Pinned apps here (or use its menu) to add it to the Homeroom widget on your home screen.
widget.hint.empty.description: Hint in the widget strip on Home while it holds no apps. "Pinned apps" is the name of the grid below; Homeroom is the product's name.

widget.tile.remove.description: Tooltip of the ✕ button on an app's tile in the widget strip on Home: takes that app off the Homeroom widget.

widget.tile.removeNamed.description: Accessible name of the ✕ button on an app's tile in the widget strip on Home. {{app}} is the app's name.

widget.removeFailed.description: Brief notice when taking an app off the Homeroom widget failed. {{reason}} is the error the phone reported.

widget.reorderFailed.description: Brief notice when saving the new order of apps on the Homeroom widget failed. {{reason}} is the error the phone reported.

waitlist.regionLabel.description: Accessible name of the card on Home where someone invited into a private community can join the waiting list to make their own apps.

waitlist.title.description: Heading of the waitlist card on the Home screen, shown to someone not yet let in: an invitation to build apps of their own. "Make" is a verb; keep it short, it is one line on a phone.

waitlist.join.button.description: Main button of the waitlist card on Home: starts joining the waiting list for creating apps.

waitlist.join.note.text: We're letting people in a few at a time.
waitlist.join.note.description: Small note under the "Join the waitlist" button on Home.

waitlist.listed.byText.text: We’ll text you when your spot is ready.
waitlist.listed.byText.description: Shown on the waitlist card once the viewer is on the list with a phone number only: they will get a text message.

waitlist.listed.byEmail.text: We’ll email you when your spot is ready.
waitlist.listed.byEmail.description: Shown on the waitlist card once the viewer is on the list with an email address.

waitlist.addEmail.link.description: Link on the waitlist card for someone listed by phone only: opens the form to add an email address as well.

waitlist.sooner.title.description: Line at the foot of the waitlist card, beside a link to a short survey that can move the viewer up the list.

waitlist.sooner.answer.description: Link beside "Want in sooner?" on the waitlist card: opens the four-question survey.

waitlist.sooner.edit.description: Link beside "Want in sooner?" on the waitlist card once the survey was answered: reopens it.

waitlist.email.titleJoin.description: Title of the email step of the waitlist card on Home, for someone not on the list yet.

waitlist.email.titleAdd.description: Title of the email step of the waitlist card on Home, for someone already listed by phone.

waitlist.email.leadOwn.text: With your email, or another one.
waitlist.email.leadOwn.description: Line under the title of the waitlist card's email step when the account already has an email address, which is filled in below. It completes the title "Join the waitlist".

waitlist.email.leadAdd.text: Add your email. We’ll email you a 6-digit code.
waitlist.email.leadAdd.description: Line under the title of the waitlist card's email step when the account has no email address.

waitlist.email.label.description: Label of the email address field on the waitlist card.

waitlist.email.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the email address field on the waitlist card: an example of an address. Keep it a valid-looking address.

waitlist.email.submitJoin.description: Submit button of the waitlist card's email step when the address is the account's own, so no code is needed.

waitlist.email.submitCode.description: Submit button of the waitlist card's email step when the address must be confirmed: sends a 6-digit code to it.

waitlist.email.privacy.text: We use it to tell you when your spot is ready, and you can sign in with it. Nobody else sees it.
waitlist.email.privacy.description: Small note under the email field on the waitlist card. "It" is the email address.

waitlist.email.notNow.description: Link under the waitlist card's email step: goes back without adding an address.

waitlist.code.title.description: Title of the waitlist card's step where the emailed code is typed in.

waitlist.code.sent.text: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 15 minutes.
waitlist.code.sent.description: Line under "Check your email" on the waitlist card. {{email}} is the address the code went to.

waitlist.code.label.description: Label of the field for the 6-digit emailed code on the waitlist card. A noun.

waitlist.code.submit.description: Submit button of the waitlist card's code step: confirms the code and joins the list.

waitlist.code.otherEmail.description: Link under the code field on the waitlist card: goes back to enter a different address.

waitlist.code.resend.description: Link under the code field on the waitlist card: emails a fresh code to the same address.

waitlist.error.join.text: Could not join the waitlist. Try again.
waitlist.error.join.description: Error on the waitlist card when joining failed and the server gave no message of its own.

waitlist.error.code.text: Could not check that code. Try again.
waitlist.error.code.description: Error on the waitlist card when the emailed code could not be checked and the server gave no message of its own.

verify.regionLabel.description: Accessible name of the card on Home that asks a member to verify their identity.

verify.title.description: Title of the card on Home that asks a member to verify their identity.

verify.lead.text: Add your phone number to vote on public apps and get the full AI budget. Nobody sees your number.
verify.lead.description: Text under "Verify your account" on Home when verifying by phone number is offered. The AI budget is the allowance of AI use each account gets.

verify.reason.text: Verified accounts vote on public apps and get the full AI budget.
verify.reason.description: Text under "Verify your account" on Home when phone verification is not offered; instructions to link other accounts follow it.

discover.heading.description: Heading of the section of Home that shows a rail of app cards to try.

discover.fallbackTitle.description: Title of Home's Discover block when the server sent none. Not shown as a heading today; kept with the block's data.

discover.browseAll.text.description: Link at the right end of the "Discover communities" heading on Home: opens the Discover screen, which lists every community the person can join. The Challenges heading's link says the same.

discover.browseAll.label.description: Accessible name of the "See all" link beside the "Discover communities" heading on Home: opens the Discover screen, which lists every community the person can join.

discover.browseAll.tip.text: See every community you can join in Discover
discover.browseAll.tip.description: Tooltip of the "See all" link beside the "Discover communities" heading on Home. Discover is the name of the screen it opens.

discover.empty.title.text: No communities to suggest right now
discover.empty.title.description: First line of the card shown in Home's Discover communities section when there is no community to suggest: none the person can join that they have not. The whole card links to the Discover screen.

discover.empty.detail.text: Discover lists every community you can join.
discover.empty.detail.description: Second line of the card shown in Home's Discover communities section when there is no community to suggest. Discover is the name of the screen the card opens.

discover.card.addTip.description: Tooltip of the labelled pill in the corner of an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail, shown when the viewer is already a member but the app is not in Pinned apps: puts a tile for the app in Pinned apps.

discover.card.addedTip.text: Added. Tap to remove from Pinned apps
discover.card.addedTip.description: Tooltip of the round check button on an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail when the app is already in Pinned apps.

discover.card.removeNamed.description: Accessible name of the round check button on an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail when the app is already in Pinned apps. {{app}} is the app's name.

discover.card.join.description: Label of the pill in the corner of an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail, shown when the viewer has not joined the app's community. Tapping it joins that community and puts a tile for the app in Pinned apps.

discover.card.joined.description: Label of the pill in the corner of an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail, shown when the viewer is a member and the app is in Pinned apps. Tapping it asks whether to leave the community.

discover.card.add.description: Label of the pill in the corner of an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail, shown when the viewer is already a member but the app is not in Pinned apps. Tapping it puts a tile for the app in Pinned apps.

discover.card.joinNamed.description: Accessible name of the Join pill on an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail. {{app}} is the app's name.

discover.card.joinedNamed.description: Accessible name of the pill on an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail when the viewer is a member and the app is in Pinned apps; tapping it asks whether to leave. {{app}} is the app's name.

discover.card.joinTip.text: Join this community. It also goes on Pinned apps
discover.card.joinTip.description: Tooltip of the Join pill in the corner of an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail. "Pinned apps" is the name of the grid on Home.

discover.card.joinedTip.text: You're a member. Tap to leave
discover.card.joinedTip.description: Tooltip of the Joined pill in the corner of an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail; tapping it opens the leave confirmation.

discover.card.addNamed.description: Accessible name of the Add pill in the corner of an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail, shown when the viewer is already a member. {{app}} is the app's name; "Pinned apps" is the name of the grid on Home.

discover.card.contributors_one.description: Small line at the bottom of an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail. {{count}} is how many people have contributed to the app.

discover.card.contributors_other.description: Small line at the bottom of an app's card in Home's Discover communities rail. {{count}} is how many people have contributed to the app.

challenges.heading.description: Heading of the section of Home about challenges (tasks that earn points), while it loads and when it shows one line because no challenge is open.

challenges.headingFirst.description: Heading of Home's Challenges section while the viewer still has a first challenge to finish: the section then lists those first challenges.

challenges.headingNext.description: Heading of Home's Challenges section once the viewer's first challenges are done: the section then lists up to 3 open challenges, the ones the viewer is furthest along first.

challenges.seeAll.text.description: Link at the right end of the Challenges heading on Home: goes to the Challenges tab, which lists every challenge.

challenges.seeAll.label.description: Accessible name of the "See all" link beside the Challenges heading on Home: goes to the Challenges tab, which lists every challenge.

challenges.allDone.title.description: Title of the one card in Home's Challenges section when nothing is open because the viewer finished every challenge of this week.

challenges.allDone.text_one.description: Line under "All done for this week" on Home. {{count}} is how many weekly challenges there are; their counts start again on Monday.

challenges.allDone.text_other.description: Line under "All done for this week" on Home. {{count}} is how many weekly challenges there are; their counts start again on Monday.

challenges.none.title.description: Title of the one card in Home's Challenges section when no challenge is open.

challenges.none.text.text: New ones will show up here.
challenges.none.text.description: Line under "No challenges right now" on Home: new challenges will appear in this section.

challenges.fallbackTitle.description: Title of Home's Challenges block when the server sent none. Kept with the block's data.

panels.fallbackTitle.description: Title of a block on the Home screen whose own title is missing. A block of Home, not the phone's home-screen widget.

challenges.row.done.description: State shown on a challenge's card on Home: the viewer has completed it.

challenges.row.started.description: State shown on a challenge's card on Home: the viewer has earned something from it but not completed it.

challenges.row.notStarted.description: State shown on a challenge's card on Home: the viewer has made no progress on it.

challenges.row.countOf.description: Progress shown on a challenge's card on Home: {{current}} done out of the {{target}} needed.

challenges.row.countOfUnit.description: Progress shown on a challenge's card on Home: {{current}} done out of the {{target}} needed. {{unit}} is the organisers' own word for what is counted, such as "apps".

challenges.row.countOfThisWeek.description: Progress shown on a weekly challenge's card on Home: {{current}} done this week out of the {{target}} needed. The count starts again every Monday.

challenges.row.countOfUnitThisWeek.description: Progress shown on a weekly challenge's card on Home: {{current}} done this week out of the {{target}} needed. {{unit}} is the organisers' own word for what is counted, such as "apps tried". The count starts again every Monday.

challenges.row.earned_one.description: Points a completed challenge paid, at the right of its title on its card on Home, in green. {{points}} is the points it paid, already formatted ("1,500"); "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

challenges.row.earned_other.description: Points a completed challenge paid, at the right of its title on its card on Home, in green. {{points}} is the points it paid, already formatted ("1,500"); "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

challenges.reward.points_one.description: A challenge's reward on its card on Home. {{points}} is the number of points as the organisers wrote it; "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

challenges.reward.points_other.description: A challenge's reward on its card on Home. {{points}} is the number of points as the organisers wrote it; "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

tone.cream.description: Name of a card colour, a pale warm off-white: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.yellow.description: Name of a card colour, a soft yellow: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.orange.description: Name of a card colour, a soft orange: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.coral.description: Name of a card colour, a pinkish orange: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.pink.description: Name of a card colour, a soft pink: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.purple.description: Name of a card colour, a soft purple: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.indigo.description: Name of a card colour, a blue-violet: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.blue.description: Name of a card colour, a soft blue: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.teal.description: Name of a card colour, a blue-green: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.mint.description: Name of a card colour, a pale green: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.sage.description: Name of a card colour, a greyish green: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.gray.description: Name of a card colour, a neutral grey: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

edit.start.description: Button beside the Pinned apps heading on Home: puts the grid into edit mode, where tiles can be moved and removed. "Edit" is a verb.

edit.startLabel.description: Accessible name of the Edit button beside the Pinned apps heading on Home. "Edit" is a verb; "Pinned apps" is the name of the section.

edit.done.description: Button beside the Pinned apps heading on Home while the grid is in edit mode: ends edit mode.

edit.removeNamed.description: Accessible name of the small round remove button on an app tile while the Pinned apps grid on Home is in edit mode. {{app}} is the app's name.

edit.addTile.description: Button beside the Pinned apps heading on Home while the grid is in edit mode, next to Done: it opens the sheet of apps not yet in Pinned apps, to add some.

addSheet.title.description: Title of the sheet that lists apps to put on Pinned apps, opened from the Add apps button beside the Pinned apps heading in edit mode. The same words as the tile menu's add action.

addSheet.yours.description: Small-caps section label in the Pin to Home sheet, over the apps this person belongs to that have no tile on Pinned apps.

addSheet.popular.description: Small-caps section label in the Pin to Home sheet, over the popular public communities the person has not joined.

addSheet.add.description: Button on a row of the Pin to Home sheet: puts that app at the end of Pinned apps.

addSheet.added.description: What a row of the Pin to Home sheet reads once its app is on Pinned apps.

addSheet.empty.description: Shown in the Pin to Home sheet when there is no app to offer: everything the person can reach is already on Pinned apps.

addSheet.browse.description: Link under the empty line in the Pin to Home sheet, to the full app directory. The same words as the link beside the Discover heading.

communities.heading.description: Heading over the grid of community tiles on Home, under Pinned apps. A community's tile opens its hub.

communities.editLabel.description: Accessible name of the Edit button beside the Pinned communities heading on Home. "Edit" is a verb.

communities.all.description: Tile at the end of Pinned communities on Home. Pressing it also shows the communities the viewer is in but has not pinned; pressing it again hides them.

communities.new.description: Tile at the end of Pinned communities on Home that starts making a new project and its community.

communities.newTip.text: Start a community and its app
communities.newTip.description: Tooltip of the New community tile at the end of Pinned communities on Home.

communities.newLocked.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the New community tile on Home when the viewer cannot make another project right now. {{hint}} is one whole sentence saying what pressing it does ('View your app allowance or request more slots.').

communities.pinNamed.description: Accessible name of the + on a community's tile shown under All communities on Home. {{community}} is the project's name.

communities.unpinNamed.description: Accessible name of the remove badge on a community's tile while Pinned communities is being edited. {{community}} is the project's name.

communities.pinned.description: Brief notice after the viewer pinned a community to Home. {{community}} is the project's name.

communities.unpinned.text: Unpinned {{community}}. You're still a member if you were.
communities.unpinned.description: Brief notice after the viewer took a community off Home; it does not leave the community. {{community}} is the project's name.

communities.failed.description: Brief notice when pinning or unpinning a community on Home failed. {{reason}} is the server's explanation.

communities.needs.description: Name under the tile in Home's Pinned communities that opens Needs you, the page of every vote and decision waiting on the viewer across their projects. Shown only while something waits.

communities.needsNamed_one.text: Needs you: {{count}} vote waiting on you
communities.needsNamed_one.description: Accessible name of the Needs you tile on Home, with how many votes wait on the viewer across their projects. Singular.

communities.needsNamed_other.text: Needs you: {{count}} votes waiting on you
communities.needsNamed_other.description: Accessible name of the Needs you tile on Home, with how many votes wait on the viewer across their projects. Plural.

join.heading.description: Heading over the cards of public communities at the bottom of Home that the viewer has not joined.

join.headingSignedOut.description: Heading over the cards of public communities at the bottom of Home for a visitor who is not signed in.

join.featured.description: Small heading over the communities the platform features, the first group of cards in Communities to join on Home (signed in or out).

join.more.description: Small heading over the rest of the community cards, after the Featured ones, in Communities to join on Home (signed in or out). Shown only when Featured is shown above it.

join.votes_one.description: Line on a community's card in Communities to join: how many changes are waiting for its members' votes. Singular.

join.votes_other.description: Line on a community's card in Communities to join: how many changes are waiting for its members' votes. Plural.

join.members_one.description: Line on a community's card in Communities to join when nothing is up for a vote: how many people are in it. Singular.

join.members_other.description: Line on a community's card in Communities to join when nothing is up for a vote: how many people are in it. Plural.

join.button.description: Button on a community's card in Communities to join: becomes a member, which also pins the community to Home.

join.buttonNamed.description: Accessible name of the Join button on a community's card. {{community}} is the project's name.

join.allJoined.text: You're in every community of this kind.
join.allJoined.description: Line in Communities to join when the chosen kind has no community the viewer is not already in.

join.loadingMore.description: Accessible name of the placeholder cards shown while the next communities load at the end of the list.

join.end.description: Line under the last card in Communities to join.

join.endKind.text: That's every public community of this kind.
join.endKind.description: Line under the last card in Communities to join when a kind is chosen.

membership.joinedPinned.description: Brief notice after the viewer joined a community; joining also pins the community to Home. {{community}} is the project's name.

membership.pinAppToo.description: Button in the notice after joining a community: also pins the community's app to Home, where its tile opens the app.

devicePins.moved_one.text: {{count}} pin from this device moved to your account
devicePins.moved_one.description: Brief notice after signing in, when an app or community pinned on this device while signed out was moved to the account. Singular.

devicePins.moved_other.text: {{count}} pins from this device moved to your account
devicePins.moved_other.description: Brief notice after signing in, when apps or communities pinned on this device while signed out were moved to the account. Plural.

guest.unpinApp.description: Accessible name of the remove badge on an app a visitor pinned on this device. {{app}} is the app's name.

guest.pinCommunity.description: Button on a project's page for a visitor who is not signed in: keeps the community on this device's Home.

guest.pinnedCommunity.description: The same button once the community is on this device's Home; pressing it again unpins it.

glass.title.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). The page title.

glass.purpose.text: What needs you, then your places.
glass.purpose.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). The one sentence under the title saying what the page is for.

glass.make.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). The page's one primary button; opens the Make screen.

glass.needs.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Label of the first group: every decision waiting on the viewer.

glass.pinnedApps.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Label of the group holding the launcher grid of pinned apps.

glass.yourCommunities.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Label of the group listing the communities the viewer pinned or joined.

glass.toJoin.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Label of the group listing public communities the viewer is not in.

glass.join.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Button on a row of Communities to join.

glass.vote.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Status word on a Needs you row whose decision waits for the viewer's vote.

glass.toVote_one.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Status on a community row: how many of its votes wait for the viewer. Singular.

glass.toVote_other.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Status on a community row: how many of its votes wait for the viewer. Plural.

glass.thisWeek.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Label of the side column's group of two facts.

glass.decisions_one.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Fact in the side column: the number of decisions in Needs you. Singular.

glass.decisions_other.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Fact in the side column: the number of decisions in Needs you. Plural.

glass.communities_one.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Fact in the side column: how many communities the viewer is in. Singular.

glass.communities_other.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Fact in the side column: how many communities the viewer is in. Plural.

glass.approve.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Status word on a Needs you row for a change on the viewer's own just-you project, whose Yes is the one it needs.

glass.waiting.checks.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Status word on a Needs you row for a change still waiting on its checks before it can be voted on.

glass.waiting.conflict.description: Home drawn in the one frame under the glass look (Settings > Experimental). Status word on a Needs you row for a change that needs its conflict with the main branch resolved before it can be voted on.
